title: Ice Cold Hydraulics at Hollywood Studios | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Ice Cold HydraulicsHosted by Coca-Cola® Located in Grand Avenue at Disney's Hollywood Studios Take a detour down Grand Avenue to refuel with tasty snacks and frosty beverages.View Menu American Snack Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Early Theme Park Entry – 8:00 AM to 9:00 AM Operating Hours – 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM Valid admission required. A theme park reservation may be required based on admission type. An Important Message Valid admission required. A theme park reservation may be required based on admission type.Rev Up Your TastebudsPull up to Ice Cold Hydraulics to enjoy delicious lite bites. Grab a seat at outdoor tables and satisfy your sweet tooth with the Candy Painted Cinnamon Roll—mini cinnamon rolls topped with Coca-Cola®-infused glaze and toasted nuts. Or, try the Bouncin’ Mini Churros—savory churros topped with Coca-Cola and bourbon candied bacon, sriracha aïoli and scallions. Wash it all down with a Frozen Slushy—made with Fanta® Blue Raspberry, Minute Maid® Lemonade or Coca-Cola.Times for Ice Cold Hydraulics
